description: Eight mono tracks each placed in a cube of eight speaker outputs, with a per-track insert, filter and two aux sends, two stereo returns, and level trims for the two halves of the output set

params.text: Moves that track along the first axis; fully anticlockwise it favours jacks 1, 3, 5 and 7, fully clockwise jacks 2, 4, 6 and 8
Moves that track along the second axis; fully anticlockwise it favours jacks 1 to 4, fully clockwise jacks 5 to 8
Moves that track along the third axis; fully anticlockwise it favours jacks 1, 2, 5 and 6, fully clockwise jacks 3, 4, 7 and 8
Sets that track's gain, 0% to 100%, before the filter and the sends
Filters that track: anticlockwise a two-pole low-pass sweeping from 22000Hz down to 20Hz, clockwise a two-pole high-pass from 10Hz up to 8000Hz, no filter in the middle
Sets how much of that track goes to the A send, 0% to 100%
Sets how much of that track goes to the B send, 0% to 100%
Trims the first four master outputs together, 0% to 100%
Trims the last four master outputs together, 0% to 100%
Trims all eight master outputs together, 0% to 100%
Sets the level of what comes back on the A return, 0% to 100%
Filters the A return: anticlockwise a two-pole low-pass from 22000Hz down to 20Hz, clockwise a two-pole high-pass from 10Hz up to 8000Hz, no filter in the middle
Sets the level of what comes back on the B return, 0% to 100%
Filters the B return: anticlockwise a two-pole low-pass from 22000Hz down to 20Hz, clockwise a two-pole high-pass from 10Hz up to 8000Hz, no filter in the middle

inputs.text: The track's mono signal, tapped straight out of the insert send before anything else touches it
Added to that track's X knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to that track's Y knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to that track's Z knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Replaces that track's signal with whatever is patched here, before the level knob, the filter and the placing; unpatched, the track's own input carries on
The left side of the A return; it is spread across the odd-numbered outputs at each track's own placing gains
The right side of the A return; it is spread across the even-numbered outputs at each track's own placing gains
The left side of the B return; it is spread across the odd-numbered outputs at each track's own placing gains
The right side of the B return; it is spread across the even-numbered outputs at each track's own placing gains

outputs.text: Every track at its A amount, added together
Every track at its B amount, added together
One corner of the cube: every track's signal at the gain its position gives this corner, through the two output trims
A copy of that track's input jack, taken before the level knob, the filter and the placing

notes: the returns are not added once; they are added into every corner at every track's placing gains, so with eight tracks running a return is summed in eight times over.
nothing here is clipped or limited. Eight tracks into eight corners with the returns folded in can put a long way past 10V out of a master jack.
menu: Send Pre-Level — takes both aux sends from the track input directly rather than after the LVL knob

inputs.32:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads that track’s own input.
